intro.summary: Southwest community of 1960s single-detached homes on large lots beside the Glenmore Reservoir and North Glenmore Park.
intro.body: Lakeview sits on the north shore of the Glenmore Reservoir, next to North Glenmore Park and the reservoir pathways. Built mostly in the 1960s, it is overwhelmingly single-detached homes on large lots. Rebuilds tend to be a larger single-detached house on the same lot rather than a lot split.
